claudemd.help: Create and maintain a project's CLAUDE.md guidelines block
claudemd.init.help: Create CLAUDE.md, or insert the managed guidelines block into an existing one
claudemd.update.help: Refresh only the managed guidelines block of CLAUDE.md
claudemd.check.help: Report what is missing or stale in CLAUDE.md (exit 2 when something is)
claudemd.arg.dir: Directory that holds CLAUDE.md (default: the current directory)
claudemd.arg.lang: Language of the guidelines block: en or pt-BR (default: the CLI language)
claudemd.arg.dry_run: Print the diff and write nothing
claudemd.placeholder.commands: Build, lint and test commands, including how to run a single test.
claudemd.placeholder.architecture: The big picture that takes several files to understand. Leave out file listings.
claudemd.placeholder.rules: Rules specific to this project. Leave out generic advice.
claudemd.note.created: New CLAUDE.md with the guidelines block and a project skeleton.
claudemd.note.inserted_after_header: Guidelines block inserted after the header; nothing else changed.
claudemd.note.inserted_top: No header found; guidelines block inserted at the top; nothing else changed.
claudemd.note.updated: Text between the markers replaced; everything outside them is untouched.
claudemd.note.current: The guidelines block is already current; nothing to change.
claudemd.error.markers_duplicate: CLAUDE.md has more than one guideline marker of the same kind. Fix the markers by hand; nothing was changed.
claudemd.error.markers_unbalanced: CLAUDE.md has a start marker without a matching end marker (or the reverse, or in the wrong order). Fix the markers by hand; nothing was changed.
claudemd.error.symlink: Refusing to touch {path}: it is a symbolic link.
claudemd.error.not_regular: Refusing to touch {path}: it is not a regular file.
claudemd.error.bad_encoding: {path} is not valid UTF-8; nothing was changed.
claudemd.error.no_block: CLAUDE.md has no managed guidelines block; run init first.
claudemd.error.no_file: No CLAUDE.md in {path}; run init first.
claudemd.error.no_template: Guidelines template for {lang} is missing from the installation.
claudemd.warn.too_long: CLAUDE.md has {lines} lines (recommended at most {limit}); it is loaded into context at every session start.
claudemd.error.bad_name: Refusing to write {path}: the file must be named CLAUDE.md.
claudemd.error.changed: {path} changed while the plan was being made; nothing was written. Run the command again.
